description.value: Grill Haven is a Middle Eastern restaurant in Fort St. John offering a menu that includes kebab wings, hummus with falafel, hummus with beef, dipping shrimp, and loaded chicken fries. It operates via a Lightspeed online ordering system and serves appetizers, mains, salads, sides, desserts, and a kids menu. For cyclists riding through the Peace River region, it offers a distinctive alternative to typical road-food options in a town that serves as a northern hub on BC Highway 97.
